export declare const OBSERVATION_COVERAGE_STATES: readonly ["complete", "not_connected", "unavailable", "lost", "truncated", "redacted", "expired", "purged", "not_applicable", "by_rule"];

export declare const OBSERVATION_ENTRIES: readonly ["workbench", "desktop", "assistant", "mcp", "cli", "workflow", "schedule", "plugin", "agent", "background", "host"];

export declare const OBSERVATION_FACT_PATTERN = "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(\\.[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)+$";

export declare const OBSERVATION_LIMITS: {
    readonly facts_per_report: 100;
    readonly fact_name: 96;
    readonly stage: 64;
    readonly subjects: 16;
    readonly evidence: 16;
    readonly detail_keys: 32;
    readonly detail_text: 512;
    readonly ref_text: 256;
    readonly report_content_bytes: number;
    readonly reports_per_minute: 60;
    readonly facts_per_reporter_day: 20000;
    readonly content_bytes_per_reporter_day: number;
    readonly snapshot_bytes: number;
};

export declare const OBSERVATION_MISSING_REASONS: readonly ["not_obtained", "truncated", "redacted", "expired", "purged", "forbidden", "by_rule"];

export declare const OBSERVATION_OUTCOMES: readonly ["succeeded", "failed", "refused", "cancelled", "waiting", "no_action", "no_response", "taken_over", "unknown"];

export declare const OBSERVATION_OWNER_SOURCE_CLASSES: readonly ["first_read", "catch_up", "imported"];

export declare const OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_ID = "system.observation";

export declare const OBSERVATION_SERVICE_PREFIXES: {
    readonly gateway: "action";
    readonly shell: "ui";
    readonly agent: "agent";
    readonly assistant: "assistant";
    readonly scheduler: "scheduler";
    readonly connections: "connections";
    readonly grants: "grants";
};

export declare const OBSERVATION_SOURCE_CLASSES: readonly ["real", "first_read", "catch_up", "imported", "trial", "replay", "demo", "system_check"];

export declare const OBSERVATION_WRITER_MISSING_REASONS: readonly ["not_obtained", "truncated", "redacted", "forbidden", "by_rule"];

export interface ObservationBackgroundOrigin {
    readonly kind: "background";
    readonly actor_id: string;
    readonly project_id: string | null;
    readonly entry: Extract<ObservationEntry, "background" | "schedule" | "agent" | "host">;
    readonly call_id?: string;
    readonly install_id?: string;
}

export interface ObservationConditions extends ObservationConditionsInput {
    readonly platform_version: string;
}

export interface ObservationConditionsInput {
    readonly plugin?: {
        readonly id: string;
        readonly version: string;
    };
    readonly prompts?: readonly {
        readonly key: string;
        readonly version: string | number;
    }[];
    readonly skills?: readonly {
        readonly id: string;
        readonly version: string | number;
    }[];
    readonly model?: {
        readonly provider: string;
        readonly model_id: string;
    };
}

export interface ObservationContent {
    readonly kind: "content";
    readonly media_type: string;
    readonly text: string;
}

export type ObservationCoverageState = (typeof OBSERVATION_COVERAGE_STATES)[number];

export type ObservationDetail = Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean>>;

export type ObservationEntry = (typeof OBSERVATION_ENTRIES)[number];

export interface ObservationEvidence {
    readonly role: string;
    readonly ref: ObservationOwnerVersionRef | ObservationSnapshotRef | ObservationMissing;
}

export interface ObservationEvidenceInput {
    readonly role: string;
    readonly ref: ObservationOwnerVersionRef | ObservationContent | ObservationMissingInput;
}

export interface ObservationFactInput {
    readonly fact: string;
    readonly outcome: ObservationOutcome;
    readonly stage?: string;
    readonly occurred_at?: string;
    readonly subjects?: readonly ObservationSubject[];
    readonly source_class?: ObservationOwnerSourceClass;
    readonly work?: {
        readonly run_id?: string;
        readonly work_ref?: string;
    };
    readonly conditions?: ObservationConditionsInput;
    readonly detail?: ObservationDetail;
    readonly evidence?: readonly ObservationEvidenceInput[];
}

export interface ObservationMissing {
    readonly kind: "missing";
    readonly reason: ObservationMissingReason;
    readonly digest?: string;
    readonly bytes?: number;
}

export interface ObservationMissingInput {
    readonly kind: "missing";
    readonly reason: ObservationWriterMissingReason;
}

export type ObservationMissingReason = (typeof OBSERVATION_MISSING_REASONS)[number];

export type ObservationOutcome = (typeof OBSERVATION_OUTCOMES)[number];

export type ObservationOwner = {
    readonly kind: "plugin";
    readonly id: string;
} | {
    readonly kind: "service";
    readonly id: ObservationService;
} | {
    readonly kind: "shell";
};

export type ObservationOwnerSourceClass = (typeof OBSERVATION_OWNER_SOURCE_CLASSES)[number];

export interface ObservationOwnerVersionRef {
    readonly kind: "owner";
    readonly owner: string;
    readonly id: string;
    readonly version: string | number;
}

export interface ObservationRecord {
    readonly record_id: string;
    readonly owner: ObservationOwner;
    readonly fact: string;
    readonly stage?: string;
    readonly outcome: ObservationOutcome;
    readonly actor: {
        readonly actor_id: string;
        readonly actor_kind?: "user" | "runtime" | null;
        readonly audience: string;
        readonly delegated_by?: string;
    };
    readonly entry: ObservationEntry;
    readonly project_id: string | null;
    readonly install_id?: string;
    readonly subjects: readonly ObservationSubject[];
    readonly occurred_at: string;
    readonly received_at: string;
    readonly clock_adjusted?: true;
    readonly work: ObservationWork;
    readonly source_class: ObservationSourceClass;
    readonly conditions: ObservationConditions;
    readonly detail: ObservationDetail;
    readonly evidence: readonly ObservationEvidence[];
    readonly coalesced?: {
        readonly count: number;
        readonly last_at: string;
    };
}

export interface ObservationRecorder {
    record(fact: ObservationFactInput): void;
}

export interface ObservationReportInput {
    readonly facts: readonly ObservationFactInput[];
}

export interface ObservationReportResult {
    readonly accepted: number;
    readonly rejected: readonly {
        readonly index: number;
        readonly code: string;
    }[];
}

export type ObservationService = keyof typeof OBSERVATION_SERVICE_PREFIXES;

export interface ObservationSink {
    bind(origin: ActionCallContext | ObservationBackgroundOrigin): ObservationRecorder;
}

export interface ObservationSnapshotRef {
    readonly kind: "snapshot";
    readonly digest: string;
    readonly bytes: number;
    readonly media_type: string;
    readonly redacted?: true;
}

export type ObservationSourceClass = (typeof OBSERVATION_SOURCE_CLASSES)[number];

export interface ObservationSubject {
    readonly kind: string;
    readonly id: string;
    readonly version?: string | number;
}

export interface ObservationWork {
    readonly call_id: string | null;
    readonly invocation_id?: string;
    readonly parent_invocation_id?: string;
    readonly runtime_session_id?: string;
    readonly run_id?: string;
    readonly work_ref?: string;
}

export type ObservationWriterMissingReason = (typeof OBSERVATION_WRITER_MISSING_REASONS)[number];

export declare const observationActions: {
    report: ActionDefinition<ObservationReportInput, ObservationReportResult>;
};
